content: Tage ya̱koum mukwatimlakay kweitan, sinap bwanabwein silma̱nin.
Kuguyes tammwayas awoum bimwamoums mananan. Kadiloka beivag asisinap bwanabwein, sona ninous didumwal. Kadiloka bisimounids bwein Yowbad waseg. Kadiloka bisiwa̱youbs bwein, o bikaptules.

Kuguyes mwamwayas-vak bivna̱ses asisinap tatineis. Awoum biwa̱wal wudous. Awoum tut babaw bimwamoums soup tawtoun, awoum. Kadiloka bikatimlakays sinap bwein, va̱gan kid tasiyas vinabwats mo bikakins sinap bwein, bivna̱ses simwa̱nas o nitsiyas.

Kadiloka vinabwats bidumwal ninous, sinap bwanabwein waseg; subwan bipiyaves; kadiloka biwotets bwein, o bisiwa̱youbs. kadiloka bikanawes simwa̱nas ages. E, kukin bitoukums biwotets bwein, tasiyas watoulan nag biyages Yowbad nakaleiwag, nag.
Kuguyes tasiyas tabwa̱bwats ma̱wan, va̱gan ninous bidumwal.

Ya̱koum-vak, mukwawotet tatoneim beibwein va̱gan bukwatimlakes sinap bwanabwein. Kulivan mounid, didumwal; amlivan mo bitawtoun wasigeis tasiyas kalisiy sivines bisenas livan kweitan, mo beivag asimwasin; peinan ta-ma̱wan biyageids tayekelesiys ya̱kids.

Kuguyes tasiyas tawteleins situwa̱vek siwotet va̱gan bikanawes ages youd babaw wasigeis, mo bikalin nuwes tasiyas situwa̱veks. Awoum bikamnimans sisiyas situwa̱veks. Awoum biba̱kews, tage wotet babaw bweina bitoukums waseg, va̱gan gamag bikines asisinap bwanabwein mo bikavasis Yowbad nakaleiwag, mtowen Takatinabweids.

Nagein gog bo ikamat Yowbad nasiwa̱youb va̱gan bikatinabweids babaw gamag ya̱kids, o bikatimlakeids sinap bwein, mo bitapiyaves sinap kalbaleb son ven watinow vikeiyan, tage bitavna̱ses Yowbad, o bitakaptuleids, adsinaps didumwal waseg.

Nagein takayamats tut wanakougwaw mwa̱saw-nen peinan takatinabweids Yeisuw Kelis igaw mo bisap, mtowen daYowbads tawtoun; bo nitam won tatonen va̱gan bikatinabweids, bitokeids mo bitalisawes sinap tasiyas kalbaleb, bivag kid adsinaps bikamnat angamag tatonen, biseiw nuwads silma̱nin wotet bwanabwein.
Sinap towen kuguyes. Amlivan tawtoun waseg kukwa̱nes. Awoum gamag mwasanin bipiyaves mukwaleiwag; awoum.
